setup.zh: 告示上写：太守效始皇故事，择日于泗水出周鼎；募善没者千人，人赏钱五百。吕梁已溺三人，太守不许停。南门里的坊市照常开着：泗滨的浮磬敲起来清得像水，淮夷的蠙珠一粒一粒装在匣子里。
setup.en: The notice says: following the First Emperor's example, the governor will raise the Zhou cauldron from the Si on a chosen day; wanted, a thousand good divers, five hundred coins each. Three have drowned at Lüliang; the governor will not stop. Inside the South Gate the market is open as ever — sounding stones from the Si bank ring clear as water, and pearls of the Huai Yi lie in boxes one by one.

recap.zh: 彭城南门的告示说，太守要效始皇，使千人没水出周鼎；吕梁已溺三人。
recap.en: At Pengcheng's South Gate a notice said the governor, like the First Emperor, would send a thousand divers after the Zhou cauldron; three had drowned at Lüliang.

text.zh: 始皇来过这儿，也捞过。绳子拉上来一半，断了。……不是鼎不肯上来，是底下有别的东西咬着。
text.en: The First Emperor came here and dragged for it too. The rope came halfway and broke. …It isn't that the cauldron won't come. Something down there is biting.

alone.zh: 当年始皇在这儿捞过，绳子拉到一半断了。不是鼎不肯上来——底下有别的东西咬着。
alone.en: The First Emperor dragged for it here once; the rope broke halfway. It is not that the cauldron will not rise: something below is biting.

text.zh: 绳子都往泗口去——泗水入淮的地方，龟山脚下。
text.en: The ropes all run to the mouth of the Si — where it meets the Huai, at the foot of Mount Gui.

label.en: To the mouth of the Si

exits.means: goes to the mouth of the Si, follows the ropes to Mount Gui

text.zh: 你顺着绳子往东南走。水声越来越响，两条水在泗口撞在一起，撞出一个漩涡。
text.en: You follow the ropes south-east. The water grows louder; at the mouth two rivers collide and spin a whirlpool.

exits.means: goes shopping, asks about the market, wants to buy or sell

text.zh: 浮磬挂在架上，风一过就响一声。卖珠的淮夷人说，珠子是蚌里养的，蚌是淮水养的。
text.en: The sounding stones hang on a frame and ring when the wind passes. The Huai Yi pearl-seller says the pearls grow in mussels, and the mussels grow in the Huai.

exits.means: goes to the governor, tells him to stop the diving, argues with the officials

text.zh: 太守的门吏把你挡在外面：太守说了，始皇没捞起来的，他来捞。
text.en: The governor's doorkeeper keeps you out: the governor says what the First Emperor could not raise, he will.

text.zh: 他捞不起来的。先去泗口。
text.en: He won't raise it. The mouth of the Si first.

alone.zh: 他捞不起来。泗口在东南。
alone.en: He will not raise it. The mouth of the Si lies south-east.
